notes.title: New Release Annoucement
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers,

It's been a while, sorry for the long wait, we'll have a major release this week!

After the update, players that already bought the game will receive the new character Stray Cat. In the meantime, the new character Ronin will be released as DLC.
We'll also be add new features such as Seasonal Tasks and Ladder Rank rewards (which will be reset and calculated on release, so you will be rewarded once if you are in the ladder board). The Journey now functions like a free Battle Pass with Weekly Rewards removed.

Lastly, [strike]we'll be adjusting the price of the base game to $12.99 after the update (other currencies will be adjusted accordingly), which won't be affecting the players that has already bought the game. [/strike][Edit: We decide to keep the price of base game as is. (April 20th)] We'll also be removing the Demo and 32 bit support after the update.

We'll see you in the new update!

notes.title: v.1.10.12 Update Log
notes.notes:
1. Game Mode Adjustment:
 a. Casual Mode is now "Normal" Mode, when new players play in this mode, they no longer need to predict islands.
  i.After reaching Expert I (1050 Ladder Points), you'll no longer be able to gain Ladder Points in this mode
  ii.You can turn on "Adventure Mode" in the match settings after reaching Expert I.
  iii.After reaching Expert II (1330 Ladder Points), "Adventure Mode" will be turned on by default.
 b. Ladder Mode is now "Adventure" Mode, it will be unlocked when you reach Expert I.
 c. Adding "Arena" Mode, unlocked after reaching Adventurer II (2500 Ladder Points)

2. Arena Mode:
 a. You can enter for free once everyday, afterwards you need 200 Coins to enter.
 b. You can pick two unlockable characters to mix and forge your deck.
 c. You deck consists of 5 sets of card packs from the two characters. Each card pack consists 3 Skill Cards and 1 Island Card, which is picked from 4 packs randomly generated from the system.
 d. You gain 1 point for winning each match, and 1 extra point for getting Big Winner. You can get rewards based on the points you get.
 e. After losing twice or winning 8 points, the arena run is completed.
 f. When you completed your run and claimed all the rewards, you can start another Arena run by either paying 200 Coins or wait till the next day.

 3. You can open ten barrels at a time now in the Pack Screen.

 4. The following cards are reworked or changed:

notes.title: June Update (v.1.9.14)
notes.notes:
Hello Adventurers! Sorry for the long wait. A lot of changes has been made since the last update, including a new in-game mechanics, a few UI reworks, better tutorials (hopefully), lots of card changes, along with some quality of life updates. 

Here are the details:
1. New mechanic "Last One Standing" -- Players will be guaranteed at least 100 Coins if they become the only active player at each stage.
2. Added 6 new skill cards
3. Added a few fast-search keywords in the card browser
4. Added a islands deduction assistant for new players
5. New players now have time (15s) to read the cards played by other players by tapping on it
6. You can now copy and share your deck
7. The deck editor can now auto-fill your deck if it's incomplete when saving.
8. You won't get duplicate Legendary cards from barrels until you get all of them
9. You can now get more deck slots
10. You can now join a friend's room through the Friends panel.
11. Some of the long lasting buff effects will now be stackable and merged into one buff.
12. Open Barrel, Store and Training Camp UI are now improved.
13. You can now set your user portrait in the Trove, and it will be visible in the Friends and Room Panel
14. Redesigned a few cards that are rarely used, rebalance a lot of Skill and Island cards.

Thanks for your long time support, happy adventuring!

notes.title: v.1.7.2 Gameplay Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, since the release of v.1.7.0, we've received feedback from a lot of players regarding card balance and various issues. We've since made a few changes about those issues and thanks in advance for your passion!

There is now one major change in our core gameplay: Your coins will now be split between other active players after you're dead.We believe this change will enhance the overall gameplay experience, making each turn more nerve-racking and balance out some of the core strategies for each character.

Hopefully, this change will negate the necessity of the Purify mechanic - a negative experience to anyone who is affected by this effect. Therefore, we made a few changes to those Purify cards across the board. In addition to that, we also tweaked the Skill Card "Funeral", which has made the ladder environment pretty toxic recently.

All in all, this is a pretty big change, and we do hope you will enjoy this as much as we do. However, we do understand that this change could potentially bring a lot of new issues and challenges, that's why we welcome any feedback and suggestions. After all, we all share the same goal of making this a better game!

Here is the change-log:
1. When your character's Health reaches 0, your coins will be split between other active players, the remaining coins will be set to 0;
2. You can now only unlock Dancer and Taoist after you reach the Master rank
3. Tweaked the ladder protection value of certain ranks
4. Card Balance Changes:

Common
-----------------------------

[Full Alert] rework: cost 0 Coins
You won't get new effects and immune Purify this turn.

Removed from your deck until the end of match

Sorry for the long wait, we've spent a long time trying to balance out the new cards we've added, now that it's finally ready for the public, here are the things in this update:

1. Added 63 new Skill cards: 10 cards for each character and 3 common cards.
2. Added a new keyword -- Wound: Whenever you restore Health, your Wound and the Health you would restore would cancel each other out.
3. You start drawing additional cards at turn 2 instead of 3. We now display how many cards are left in your deck.
4. The longest wait time in the Casual Mode is now 180s instead of 40s.
5. There's a red dot on the UI when there are rewards to collect in the Training Camp.

notes.title: Dear Sealords, X.D. Network is the new publisher of [Journey of Greed].
notes.notes:
Dear Sealords,

Hello everyone, we are very happy to announce that we, X.D. Network, is now working with Dird Games and will be handling the publishing and operation of Journey of Greed PC version and the mobile version that you have all been waiting for.When the time comes, every sea lords will be able to sail on your mobile device and earn a pot full! Additionally, Journey of Greed will release a update on June 8th. Adding in 63 new cards and starting a week of 15% off discount!

Journey of Greed developed by Dird Games is a game that has the rigorous strategy experience of traditional board games with an absurd style of presentation. Players can be unyielding (greedy) and fearless (defrauding). We think that Journey of Greed will definitely be like a fish in water on mobile.
Dird Games got overwhelmingly positive on steam since the beginning is not only the result of the great pricing decision and well-polished gameplay but also the support from you -- the players that would support a good game. We hope to help improve the game and build a better, bigger community after officially becoming the publisher. And for the mobile version, crossplay is in the schedule. We will be listening to your feedback and help Dird Game on making sure the game is in a good place. Keep the feedback coming as usual!

XD has always been dedicated to finding and supporting outstanding indie games. We hope to bring more and more hidden gems from the woods to the grand palace, letting more and more players to experience the unique and fun games.

Thank you for reading our announcement, the great journey awaits! The sea of treasures is bound to be yours!

2. You can now tweak your match settings for Bot and Room mode, including:
[list]
[*]  Fast Mode: The pace (animations, cards' display time) will be a lot faster in the fast mode, so if you are still learning the cards, don't turn it on...
[*]  Seer Mode: You get to know the color of the islands during the scan, no need to burn your brain anymore. You can turn this on to learn the correlation between island composition and compass color, or to test your deck strength without worrying about what the next island is gonna be. Don't turn this on if you want to have the full experience.
[*]  Think Time: How long you get to think before having to play your card or make a choice.
[/list]

Bear in mind that in Ladder, Fast Mode will be turned on after the first rank, Seer Mode will always be turned off, and think time is 15s.

notes.title: v.0.3.3 You ask and we deliver... sort of
notes.notes:
A lot of you have asked for the ability to mark the compass color on previous islands. And we've debated if we should implement this or not for a long time, since part of the "skill" is to memorize and guess what's next based on your memory. However, it has become a burden that you have to overcome to enjoy the core game, and memorizing is never "fun".

So there you go, we did it, but in a slightly different way. Having to mark every island you've stepped on would eventually become a chore. Why not show it directly, in a less obnoxious way? 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34736178/8e8adf5e3b3ab06b6087c40d1de32b49f98f3f34.png[/img]

So here is what we did, for v.0.3.3:
1. Added an "eye" at the top of the compass, holding it would show you the compass color of the last two rounds on the map.
2. Improved the marker a little bit.

Enjoy!

notes.title: About this Early Access
notes.notes:
First of all, a huge thanks to everyone participated in our closed Alpha. We've been making this game for over a year, and sometimes you can't see the whole picture if you've dived in too deep. And your feedbacks really helped us see things clearer, such as what the game really is about and what we should focus on. And it warms our heart to see so many people playing our game and having fun, which reaffirmed our determination for this early access release.

Now that we are launching Early Access, I want to take the time to address some of the common questions:

1. Are there micro transactions?
No, since we are charging you up front, the packs you get with in-game currency is more of a progression rather than a way to grind you out.

2. I don't have 3 buddies to play with, can I play this by myself?
Of course! You can use the ladder or casual mode to play online. And you can still use the custom room even if you don't have exactly 4 people to play with, the system will just fill the empty slots with bots (difficulty depends on your average rank).

3. Looks a bit cartoon-ish, is this game for me?
We chose this style mainly because of the comedy theme we are going for. While the game can be stupidly fun and hilarious to play with your friends, it is actually pretty hardcore and brain consuming to play with high rank/skill players. So I would say if you are a board game lover, a hardcore TCG player, or just want to find a game to play and banter with your friends, this might be for you!

4. What are the chances to gain rare cards?
You can get at least one legendary card for every ten packs. Again, we are not using card packs for monetization purpose, you should find it pretty easy and fair to get packs and rare cards. More importantly, if we've done everything right, more cards just guarantee more strategy, but it doesn't guarantee a win. 

5. What is your plan for the future?
While you can play with your friends using custom rooms, we do recognize the importance of the friends feature, so that's our most immediate concern.
Besides the weekly tweaks and changes. Other big stuff that's on our plate: fill in more chapters (with challenges and rewards) for the campaign; A new character and more cards; custom expressions.
Also, we did receive some comments about the art and music in the game over the last few weeks. If the budget permits, we will start looking into how to improve the art and music.
All of this can be changed based on feedbacks, part of the reason why we are doing Early Access. 

Thanks again everyone for your interest in our game! At the end of the day, we are just a small team of 3, so if you enjoy our game, share it and get the word out, it would help us a lot. Thanks for playing!
